subject.title: fix: render workspace avatars in identity card

question: After the public SDK compatibility issue is repaired, should this PR be the canonical avatar-401 landing path and accept the stricter local-avatar projection behavior?
rationale: Automation can make the narrow SDK repair, but only maintainers can choose the canonical PR among overlapping fixes and accept the user/API compatibility policy.

options.title: Repair and use this PR
options.body: Keep the owner-level projection, restore SDK compatibility, and land this branch as the canonical fix if the stricter local-avatar policy is acceptable.

options.title: Preserve older list behavior
options.body: Require the branch to keep `agents.list` compatibility and change only the identity/bootstrap paths that produced protected routes.

options.title: Defer to a narrower PR
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer an overlapping smaller PR as the landing vehicle for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Repair and use this PR
recommendation.body: Keep the owner-level projection, restore SDK compatibility, and land this branch as the canonical fix if the stricter local-avatar policy is acceptable.
